text.p: Zinc and lead producer Metaleurop, a unit of Germany's Preussag, said on Wednesday that it did not plan to pay a dividend for fiscal 1996/97 despite prospects for improved earnings.
"There will be no dividend for the current fiscal year," board member Claus Grosse, responsable for finances, told reporters.
Grosse said Metaleurop last paid a dividend of four francs per share for the 1989 year.
Asked about earnings prospects for the year ending September 30, 1997, he said a "sharp improvement was expected" but declined to elaborate.
He said the company was profitable from October 1996 to January 1997, the last month for which data was available.
The non-ferrous metal producer reported a 1995/96 profit of 42 million francs, compared with a loss of 122 million for the preceding year.
